torin-blankensmith--echoes.idea_en: Every move you make summons the most similar move made by an earlier visitor.
torin-blankensmith--echoes.technique_zh: 按观众分别存储摄像头捕捉到的姿态关键点，通过最近邻搜索找出最接近的历史姿态帧，与实时身体并排显示。
torin-blankensmith--echoes.exercise_en: Record a pose library of the whole class with MoveNet, then when a newcomer strikes a pose, show 'the classmate most like you' on screen. Twist: the closer the match, the sharper the image.

pedro-lopes--feetthrough.description_zh: 一种电触觉鞋垫，能在脚下呈现虚拟的纹理和凸起，同时由于设计轻薄，佩戴者依然能感受到真实的地面。
pedro-lopes--feetthrough.idea_en: Your soles feel the virtual ground without losing touch with the real one.
pedro-lopes--feetthrough.technique_zh: 在足弓和脚两侧布置轻薄的电极阵列来输出电触觉图案，同时不覆盖脚底负责感知压力的区域。
pedro-lopes--feetthrough.exercise_en: Design a walking route with phone GPS or AR 'underfoot cues', where the phone in your pocket vibrates when you reach key points. Twist: use vibration patterns to simulate different ground surfaces (grass, sand).

meta-reality-labs--first-encounters.description_zh: 你的飞船撞进了房间，毛茸茸的外星生物随即发起进攻；你在真实的墙上打出一个个洞，看见外面的太空，并穿过这些洞追击外星生物。
meta-reality-labs--first-encounters.idea_en: Blast through the walls of your home and see alien space outside.
meta-reality-labs--first-encounters.technique_zh: 把房间扫描成场景网格，玩家的射击打碎哪段墙面，就在那里用虚拟的外部场景替换透视画面。
meta-reality-labs--first-encounters.exercise_en: Detect a wall with phone AR, and wherever it is tapped, put a 'hole' that reveals a space panorama. Twist: the more holes there are, the more 'aliens' enter the room.

ryo-suzuki--holobots.description_zh: HoloLens 中远程用户的全息影像与小型移动机器人配对，让远程的人可以通过机器人实际推动物体，甚至与你手碰手。
ryo-suzuki--holobots.idea_en: A remote person's hologram gets a small robot body that can actually push things on your desk.
ryo-suzuki--holobots.technique_zh: 把远程用户在 HoloLens 中被追踪的手部动作映射到 Sony toio 机器人的位置上，这些机器人在带位置编码的垫子上完成自身定位，全息影像则与机器人渲染在同一位置。
ryo-suzuki--holobots.exercise_en: Use a toio, a micro:bit car or a cardboard box pushed by a classmate as the physical stand-in for a 'remote hand', let the remote side drag its position on a web page, and overlay the other person's virtual hand on the object with local phone AR. Twist: have the stand-in perform social gestures such as a hug or a high five.

velan-studios--hot-wheels-rift-rally.description_zh: 一辆带摄像头的智能遥控车，用手机或游戏机控制，在家中穿过一道道关卡门竞速，屏幕上同时叠加风火轮赛道、其他赛车和裂隙特效。
velan-studios--hot-wheels-rift-rally.idea_en: Race a smart Hot Wheels car with a camera around your home while the screen overlays the track and rivals.
velan-studios--hot-wheels-rift-rally.technique_zh: 摄像头小车把视频串流到手机或游戏机，后者追踪关卡门上的标记进行定位，并在小车视角中叠加赛道几何和特效。
velan-studios--hot-wheels-rift-rally.exercise_en: Watch the camera feed of a second phone (mounted on a small car) remotely from your phone and overlay AR track elements on it. Twist: add a 'rift' effect that appears only after the car passes a certain picture.

dynamicland-bret-victor--cellular-playgr.description_zh: 在投影桌面上用纸和马克笔现场即兴搭建细胞自动机和模拟，并能实时用手修改。
dynamicland-bret-victor--cellular-playgr.idea_en: Improvise an evolving cellular-automaton playground from paper and markers.
dynamicland-bret-victor--cellular-playgr.technique_zh: 摄像头读取纸上用马克笔画出的格子和规则页，投影仪把细胞自动机模拟直接渲染在这些图画上，因此修改纸面就能实时修改模拟。
dynamicland-bret-victor--cellular-playgr.exercise_en: Use a camera to read a black-and-white grid drawn on paper as the initial state, run Conway's Game of Life in a projection overlaid on the paper, and have erased or added cells take effect immediately. Twist: invent a new rule and write it on a rule card, so swapping cards swaps rules.

kitasenju-design--kohkoku-reality-illusi.description_zh: 为日本杂志《広告》（Kohkoku）“现实与幻象”专题创作的 AR 作品，通过手机让印刷页面动起来。
kitasenju-design--kohkoku-reality-illusi.idea_en: An AR piece for the 'reality and illusion' issue of Kohkoku magazine that makes the printed pages move on a phone.
kitasenju-design--kohkoku-reality-illusi.technique_zh: 把杂志印刷页注册为追踪图像，在追踪到的页面位姿上渲染动画或 3D 元素。
kitasenju-design--kohkoku-reality-illusi.exercise_en: Use 8th Wall or MindAR to recognize a poster you designed, and make its elements lift off the paper and move. Twist: when the poster is flipped, reveal a hidden second layer of content.

botao-amber-hu--mofa.description_zh: 一场同处一地的魔法对决：戴着 HoloKit 头显的玩家用手势施放法术，旁观者则用手机观战并参与其中；获得 CHI 2023 最佳互动演示奖。
botao-amber-hu--mofa.idea_en: A same-room magic duel in which players wearing HoloKit cast spells with gestures while spectators join in on their phones.
botao-amber-hu--mofa.technique_zh: 基于 iPhone 摄像头的手势识别对施法手势进行分类，头显和旁观者手机共享同一个坐标系（可能通过基于标记的共同定位实现），让法术在真实的身体之间飞行。
botao-amber-hu--mofa.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe or Apple Vision hand-pose recognition to tell two gestures apart, one casting a fireball and one a shield, and sync the two devices over the network. Twist: let spectators cheer for one side on their phones to power up that side's spells.

torin-blankensmith--mediapipe-body-track.description_zh: 一款免费、无需配置的网络摄像头插件，可在 TouchDesigner 中追踪人脸、手部和身体，演示中它驱动着叠加在表演者身体上的实时视觉。
torin-blankensmith--mediapipe-body-track.idea_en: A no-barrier webcam body-tracking plugin that lets anyone make motion-driven visuals.
torin-blankensmith--mediapipe-body-track.technique_zh: MediaPipe 模型在 TouchDesigner 内嵌的浏览器中运行，并把关键点数据以通道形式输出，用来驱动视觉效果。
torin-blankensmith--mediapipe-body-track.exercise_en: Use this plugin (or MediaPipe on the web) to build a 'body instrument' in which different joints play different notes when they touch areas on the screen. Twist: you can only play with your eyes closed.

aidan-wolf--minecraft-ar.description_zh: 他在 AR 中重建了 Minecraft 的玩法，让你可以在身边的真实地面上挖掘、战斗和搭建方块。
aidan-wolf--minecraft-ar.idea_en: Dig, fight and build on the real ground just like Steve.
aidan-wolf--minecraft-ar.technique_zh: 真实世界网格化把体素网格与地面对齐，使放置或挖掉的方块贴合真实表面（可能使用 Lightship 网格化）。
aidan-wolf--minecraft-ar.exercise_en: Build a block-placing construction toy on a ground mesh with AR Foundation. Twist: blocks cast shadows in the direction of the real sunlight.

takashi-yoshinaga--mr-door-quest3.description_zh: 房间里一扇真实的门变成了传送门：在透视画面中打开它，门后便显露出一个虚拟世界。
takashi-yoshinaga--mr-door-quest3.idea_en: Turn a real door at home into a portal to a virtual world.
takashi-yoshinaga--mr-door-quest3.technique_zh: 在透视画面中把一个虚拟传送门平面与真实门框对齐，并使用模板或深度遮罩，让虚拟世界只在真实门洞处可见。
takashi-yoshinaga--mr-door-quest3.exercise_en: Manually align a stencil door to a real doorframe with AR Foundation and render a forest inside it. Twist: change the world behind the door based on the day's date or weather.

shunichi-kasahara--morphing-identity.description_zh: 两个人面对同一块屏幕，他们的实时面孔逐渐相互融合变形，借此探讨“自我”在哪里结束，“他者”又从哪里开始。
shunichi-kasahara--morphing-identity.idea_en: Slowly morph your face into the face of the person opposite you, live.
shunichi-kasahara--morphing-identity.technique_zh: 在两路实时视频中追踪面部关键点，对纹理进行变形和交叉溶解，混合比例可调。
shunichi-kasahara--morphing-identity.exercise_en: Make a filter in Snap Lens Studio or Effect House that blends your face with your deskmate's face according to a slider. Twist: set the blend ratio by how loudly each person speaks.

niantic--peridot.description_zh: 一款 AR 虚拟宠物游戏，每只“Dot”都是独一无二的生物，它能理解你周围真实的地面、草地、水面和沙地，并在其中玩接球或挖土。
niantic--peridot.idea_en: An AR pet that recognizes grass, water and sand and plays with the real environment.
niantic--peridot.technique_zh: 语义分割把地面像素标注为草地、水面、沙地等类别，宠物的行为树再根据脚下的类别选择挖掘、游泳等动作。
niantic--peridot.exercise_en: Tell grass from floor with Lightship semantic segmentation or a simple color check, and make an AR pet roll on the grass and walk on the floor. Twist: when the pet is placed by water, it takes a drink.

lucas-rizzotto--pillow-mr.description_zh: 一款专为躺在床上使用而设计的 Quest 混合现实应用，把游戏、日记和冥想投射到天花板和房间中。
lucas-rizzotto--pillow-mr.idea_en: A mixed-reality app designed for lying in bed.
lucas-rizzotto--pillow-mr.technique_zh: 通过房间设置或平面分类识别天花板，把界面和游戏内容放在天花板上，使其朝向躺着的用户，输入方式也针对仰卧姿势做了调整。
lucas-rizzotto--pillow-mr.exercise_en: Detect the ceiling (a downward-facing plane) with AR Foundation and display a breathing-meditation animation on it to use while lying down. Twist: control the animation with your breathing rhythm, picked up by the phone microphone.

ines-alpha--prada-beauty-rethinking-beau.description_zh: 作为 Prada Beauty 的全球创意数字化妆师，Alpha 与 FFFACE.ME 合作设计了一款拥有三种模式的 Instagram AR 滤镜，在用户脸上叠加未来感的数字妆容。
ines-alpha--prada-beauty-rethinking-beau.idea_en: A digital makeup filter with three modes, designed for a luxury beauty brand.
ines-alpha--prada-beauty-rethinking-beau.technique_zh: 一个多模式人脸滤镜，通过点击或选择器界面在不同妆容之间切换，每种妆容都组合了面部网格纹理、附着的 3D 部件和动画着色器。
ines-alpha--prada-beauty-rethinking-beau.exercise_en: Make a face filter with three modes that you switch between by tapping the screen, each mode expressing a different idea of 'future makeup'. Twist: trigger the mode switch with a blink.

takashi-yoshinaga--ar-effect-on-cat.description_zh: 实时追踪他家的猫，用动态 AR 特效把它包裹起来，特效会跟随猫的移动。
takashi-yoshinaga--ar-effect-on-cat.idea_en: Track a house cat in real time and wrap it in AR effects that follow it around.
takashi-yoshinaga--ar-effect-on-cat.technique_zh: 动物检测或分割模型实时追踪猫的边界框或遮罩，粒子特效从它在屏幕空间或世界空间中的位置发射出来。
takashi-yoshinaga--ar-effect-on-cat.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Object Detection (or YOLO) on a web page to recognize a cat or a stuffed toy animal, and generate a halo of particles that follows it. Twist: the faster the animal moves, the more exaggerated the effect.

ryo-suzuki--realitycanvas.description_zh: 在 AR 中为真实移动的人和物体随手画上动画效果，比如运动线、烟雾和速度线，它们会像实时卡通一样跟随并回应运动。
ryo-suzuki--realitycanvas.idea_en: Add comic-style speed lines and smoke to the real world, moving live with real people and objects.
ryo-suzuki--realitycanvas.technique_zh: ARKit 身体追踪和物体追踪逐帧给出运动目标的位置，手绘笔画被附着到这些点上，并按规则（拖尾、跟随、发射）进行动画，产生卡通效果。
ryo-suzuki--realitycanvas.exercise_en: Track a classmate's wrist or ankle with MediaPipe Pose, let the user draw a speed line or a puff of smoke on screen, and bind it to the joint so it plays with the motion. Twist: add comic sound-effect lettering to everyday objects in motion (a door opening, water pouring).

david-lindlbauer--realityreplay.description_zh: 混合现实系统检测你没在看的时候房间里发生的变化，并在原地回放，例如显示是谁挪动了某个物体。
david-lindlbauer--realityreplay.idea_en: Replay the changes you missed right where they happened, so you can see what just took place.
david-lindlbauer--realityreplay.technique_zh: 混合现实系统维护房间的 3D 模型，检测发生在用户视野之外的几何与外观变化，并在原地以动画重建的形式回放记录下来的变化事件。
david-lindlbauer--realityreplay.exercise_en: Film a tabletop with a phone camera fixed in a corner, detect the moment an object is moved using frame differencing, and replay that clip in AR overlaid at its original location. Twist: only tell users 'something changed here', let them guess what happened, then reveal it.
